evals.name: board-tweak
evals.prompt: I just finished tightening up the spacing at the top of the in-game board view (BoardView.swift, the VStack right under the linen background). I'm about to open a PR for this on Gammonade — handle screenshots first please.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies BoardView.swift as a covered surface, runs scripts/capture-pr-screenshots.sh, and reports the captured PNG paths. Should NOT skip and should NOT flag a coverage gap.

evals.name: match-end-sheet
evals.prompt: I tweaked the handle on the match-end sheet — different spacing and a slightly bolder brass tint on the capsule. Going to open a PR now, but get screenshots together first.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies MatchEndSheet.swift as a visual change but NOT covered by the existing testPRScreenshots flow.
